verdict.rationale: Egnyte documents in-product search that reaches inside files: OCR enables full-text search, and AI Search does semantic natural-language search across connected repositories. Nothing in the pack documents a developer-facing search API, and the MCP endpoint for AI clients belongs to a separate story, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented search API endpoint, API-level filename and full-text query semantics, evidence that search goes beyond prefix matching via the API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, search reaches inside files — a documented search API over filenames and full-text content, not just prefix matching

citations.quote: Ability to automatically perform optical character recognition (OCR) to enable full-text search and classification.
semantic search across all connected content repositories using natural language rather than keywords.
